verdict_reason: The rekey to commodity code and the new refusal warn logs are correct, but the file keeps rationale and UI-describing comments, one of them edited by this diff.

todos.issue: The three comment blocks (lines 12-15, 27-30, 49-52) carry rationale and describe the UI and callers rather than the lines below: 'it saves them spotting a link on an empty page', 'it submits the page form — the crumb travels with it and no GET can trigger it', 'The page only offers it for the commodities the design lists species by species'.
